text: INTERPRETER receiver dispatch rule at run time (veto taint.rs:1414-1476): impl_method_sealed (the tree MethodCall arm under T) takes the receiver's own taint and calls t_check_dispatch after seal_method/seal_dispatch; t_check_dispatch returns at once unless the receiver carries TYP or PICK (new taint bit, veto taint.rs:71), and t_check_dispatch_tainted refuses an untyped or picked receiver when the method selects between operator impls. t_rules (veto taint.rs:725) gates t_check_names/t_check_width/t_check_dispatch: always true outside cfg(test). Per-thread cfg(test) switches DISPATCH_RULE_OFF (read by seal_name_args, seal_dispatch, seal_width, seal_width_unary) and TAINT_FORCE_ON (read by t_rules), default off. goal.rs: run_goal/_warm/_random/_categorical/_multistart/_tournament apply seal_call to the goal fn, and unknown_goal_name gives a sealed caller the no-such-fn text (veto goal.rs, interp.rs:4946). TEST-ONLY interp/dispatch_tests.rs; sink_tests turn TAINT_FORCE_ON on where they judge the runtime taint. The VM and unsealed runs never reach the new code (impl_method_sealed only under T; seal_call returns unless seal.active); every sealed run is still refused (SEAL_RUNTIME_COMPLETE = false)
